name: history-keeper
description: Keep a copy of every Claude Code session that the 30-day cleanup cannot delete, as JSONL and readable markdown, with message times in the transcript and /history to list and search old sessions.

vaultDir.title: Vault folder
vaultDir.description: Where session copies go, one folder per project. ~ is your home folder.

vaultEveryMinutes.title: Copy at most every (minutes)
vaultEveryMinutes.description: After a turn, copy the session again only if this many minutes passed since the last copy. 0 copies after every turn. The session's end always copies.

markdown.title: Write markdown
markdown.description: Write a readable .md beside each .jsonl copy: prompts, replies and tool names with times. /history searches it.

timestamps.title: Times in the transcript
timestamps.description: off; prompts puts a dim local time beside each of your prompts; all also beside the first block of each reply.
